mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, t.name AS teacherName, c.credit, c.schedule, cs.selection_time AS selectionTime, cs.score FROM course_selection cs JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.status = 0 ORDER BY cs.selection_time DESC

SELECT c.name AS courseName, c.credit, cs.score, s.name AS semesterName FROM course_selection cs JOIN course c ON cs.course_id = c.id JOIN semester s ON c.semester_id = s.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId} AND cs.score IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cs.selection_time DESC

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS studentName, s.major, s.class_name AS className, cs.score FROM course_selection cs JOIN student s ON cs.student_id = s.id WHERE cs.course_id = #{courseId} AND cs.status = 0 ORDER BY s.student_no
